assumptions.assumption: Large standing orders are those with order.amount strictly greater than 2802.0 (the cutoff itself is excluded).
All rows in the order table are treated as standing orders, since the table holds permanent orders. No extra filter is applied.

alternatives.interpretation: Large means amount at or above the cutoff (>= 2802.0).
